units.source_text: 他这位小姐呢，虽然不是一个绝色美女，但亦温顺优雅，聪明伶俐，并不亚于身份高贵的女子。

en.t: His young lady, though not a peerless beauty, was gentle, graceful, clever, and in no way inferior to women of noble birth.

units.source_text: 她自己常自伤境遇，想道：“身份高贵的男子呢，怕以我为微不足数；身份相当的人呢，我又决不肯嫁与。

en.t: She often grieved over her own circumstances and thought, "Men of high rank would probably consider me beneath notice, while I would never agree to marry someone of equal status.

units.source_text: 如果我寿命稍长，父母先我而死，那时我就削发为尼，或者投海自尽吧。”

en.t: If I live a little longer and my parents die before me, then I will shave my head and become a nun, or perhaps throw myself into the sea."

units.source_text: 她父亲关怀这女儿，无微不至。

en.t: Her father cared for this daughter with the most painstaking attention.

units.source_text: 每年两度带她去向住吉明神参拜。

en.t: Twice each year, he took her to worship before the Sumiyoshi deity.

units.source_text: 女儿自己也私下祷告，希求明神保佑。

en.t: The daughter herself also prayed in private, hoping for the deity's protection.
For now, let this matter be set aside.
